title: Local SSD Space Reclamation & External Storage Archive Pipeline
hypothesis: Automating the identification of cold historical artifacts, legacy package caches, and oversized model checkpoints, paired with an external drive migration runbook, will reclaim >= 40 GiB on the 16GB M1 MacBook Pro internal drive without breaking git continuity or agent skill discovery.
falsification_criteria: Archive procedure breaks active APM skill symlinks, deletes unarchived source files, or reclaims < 15 GiB of storage.

model_routing.frontier_escalation_condition: Only escalate to cloud LLM if automated dependency resolution encounters circular symlink deadlock

evidence.details: Closed at Richard's request 2026-11-08 without testing the hypothesis: no automated cold-artifact identification pipeline or external-drive runbook was built (no external drive attached). Operational goal met manually: Richard approved deleting ~/.crc/cache (unused 2023 OpenShift Local 4.12/4.13 bundles, 44 GB); free space 11 GiB -> 56 GiB; git and skill discovery unaffected.

lessons_learned: The largest reclaimable item on the M1 was an unused OpenShift Local (crc) bundle cache (44 GB); Podman's VM disk (~22 GB) had only 1.25 GB reclaimable images.
Remaining candidates if needed: Chrome cache 5.5 GB, uv cache 2 GB, copilot/node-gyp/apm caches ~2.5 GB, Podman images plus VM disk compaction.

projected_impact.basis: Declared 2026-11-04 by claude-code (MISSION-031 backfill) from the mission's hypothesis; a mission always also edits its own manifest. Refine at checkout and confirm with `manage_coordination.py verify`.
